title: Configured route — an exploded view: the sheet, the bodies, their trays, the numbered steps and the supplied state, with the links supplied between them
titleEs: Ruta de recurso — Mecanismo o relación explicada
description: An exploded view of a route configured between abstract bodies: the pieces start close together — each body's plate (all the same size, on one row) with its intake tray, the numbered steps of the route under the trays, the placeholder sheet in its column and the state piece beside the route — and are pulled apart, the sheet and the state piece growing to full size. Only the supplied relationships are drawn, each in its kind's style (a plain relation has end dots and no arrowhead; causal only when supplied). A tracer follows the supplied traversal along the drawn links and along every numbered step in the supplied order; the piece it reaches enlarges, the focus most. Illustrative; no rank, admissibility, time limit, ground or outcome is drawn; jurisdiction unspecified.

content.note: Visual illustration only. It does not state the law of any jurisdiction or decide validity, responsibility or outcomes.

durationMs.description: Total length of the finite timeline in milliseconds. Phases scale proportionally; the final state is held.

seed.description: Seed for small deterministic variations (appearance defaults, hand-drawn jitter). Same seed + time + params = same frame.

locale.description: Language of built-in labels (en or es). User-supplied text is never translated.

theme.description: Render treatment. Only tested themes are listed.

palette.description: Colour palette applied to props, actors and accents.

background.description: transparent, paper, white, light-grey, charcoal or a #rrggbb colour.

safeArea.description: Caption-safe margins as fractions of the frame.

reducedMotion.description: Removes decorative motion (overshoot, idle sway, camera drift) while keeping instructional motion.

textVisibility.description: all labels, key labels only, or none (the action must remain readable without labels).

jurisdiction.description: Descriptive jurisdiction tag. "unspecified" means no legal system is asserted.

contentNotice.description: Shows a small "illustrative example" tag inside the safe area.

title.description: Name of the decision document (fictional, as supplied)

decisions.description: The decision document (fictional; a placeholder sheet — no text is drawn on it)

label.description: Label of the body (fictional, as supplied)

bodies.description: Abstract bodies (fictional), drawn as stations of the same size on one row, in this order (array replaces the previous value)

steps.description: The configured route: indices in `bodies`, in the supplied order (consecutive repeats are ignored). Each step between two of them is drawn and numbered; direction comes only from this order (array replaces the previous value)

routes.description: The route as configured (as supplied): abstract, fictional bodies of the same size on one row, and the supplied order in which the document passes them. No rank, level or hierarchy is drawn or implied

b.description: Caption of ◆ (route not checked, as supplied: a pending state)

outcomes.description: Captions of the two supplied route states (equal weight; nothing is inferred from either)

route.description: Heading of the configured route (keep "as supplied")

sequence.description: Caption of the numbered steps (keep "as configured")

key.description: Neutral key (must say that no conclusion is drawn)

routeState.description: The supplied route state shown on the state piece: a (● available, the steps drawn solid) or b (◆ not checked — a pending state, the steps drawn dashed)

elements.description: Labels of the pieces (listed in the panel beside each piece's glyph); ids are fixed by the scene, labels are editable (array replaces the previous value)

link.description: Which two pieces it links: the sheet and the first body of the route, each body and its tray, the trays and the steps that start or end there, the state and the route

kind.description: relation | communication | sequence | causal (causal only when the author supplies it)

relationships.description: Explicit relationships between pieces; the kind sets the line (a plain relation has end dots and no arrowhead; causal only when supplied). A link not listed is not drawn (array replaces the previous value)

focusElement.description: Element enlarged most when the tracer reaches it

relationLabels.description: Caption of each relation kind (listed in the panel beside the line style)

traversalOrder.description: Order in which the tracer visits the pieces; it moves along a drawn link between two consecutive pieces (and along every step of the route), and starts afresh where no link joins them (array replaces the previous value)

labels.sequence: Steps numbered in the supplied order (illustrative)
